svg.title: GHOSTWHEEL Fourier Epicycles | From signal to decision
svg.desc: Actual Fourier epicycles draw the outline of a fictional ASTER vehicle. A gateway accepts an authorized simulated steering command, rejects a replayed command, requests a virtual safe state, and records an evidence event. Open the linked interactive campaign for the full experience.
svg.text: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN A CAR REFUSES TO OBEY?
THE COMMAND IS SIMPLE. THE DECISION ISN'T.
